ValidationRule.description: Validate if expected settlement date falls on a weekday
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MLCRM_Opportunity', NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Expected_Settlement_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Expected_Settlement_Date__c)), OR(Expected_Settlement_Date__c <= TODAY(), CASE(MOD(Expected_Settlement_Date__c - DATE(1900, 1, 7), 7), 0, 0, 6, 0, 1) = 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Expected Settlement Date must be in future and must fall on a weekday
